name: Radical*Tender
source:
When Touichi's house burned to the ground, his aunt shipped him to a school full of nothing but hot girls.
Touichi could barely make sense of things, but was soon the target of three particular beauties that, despite their age, seemed very mature.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072578.html]DLsite English[/url]]
